title: CreateClaimRequest
description: The request schema for the CreateClaim operation

declaredValue.description: This is required for off-Amazon shipments to determine value of shipments

isReplacementPackageSent.description: Applicable for only On Amazon shipments to identify if replacement was sent

ClaimProofURLs.description: A list of proof URLs for a claim. Basic URL validation will happen for each URLs present in the list

ClaimReason.description: The reason for which shipper is filing the claim for a particular shipment.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: Shipment was received in damaged condition
Shipment was delivered but is not received
Shipment was delivered but the content is missing/different
Cash was collected from customer but delivery agent marked it rejected

Currency.description: The monetary value in the currency indicated, in ISO 4217 standard format.

SettlementType.description: Type of settlement the shipper wants to receive for a particular shipment.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: File a claim for item value to get refund.
File a claim to request for a COF[Certificate Of Fact].

TrackingId.description: The carrier generated identifier for a package in a purchased shipment.
